title: Apple’s privacy pillars in focus
description: At Apple, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right. Learn about our four pillars of privacy, how we brought these principles together to design iCloud Private Relay, and how you can approach building privacy in your app in line with those fundamentals. Explore how you can build data minimization, on-device processing, transparency and control, and security protections right into your app.

resources.title: App Store Guidelines: User Privacy and Data Use
Human Interface Guidelines: Accessing User Data
resources.description: User privacy is paramount. To help people trust your app, it’s crucial to be transparent about the privacy-related data and resources you require and how you use them.

resources.title: Introducing Private Click Measurement, PCM
resources.description: This blog post covers a new feature called Private Click Measurement, or PCM, for measuring ad clicks across websites and from iOS apps to websites. It is part of iOS and iPadOS 14.5.
